newsitem.title: USA: Atrix says investor takes 5.3 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Atrix says investor takes 5.3 pct stake.

text.p: Atrix International Inc said Thurday that Jerry Mathwig, an investor based in Eden Prairie, Minn., has acquired 300,000 common shares of Atrix, giving him a 5.3 percent stake in the company.
An Atrix spokesman said that Mathwig, in a recent Securities and Exchange Commission filing, stated he bought the stake in the company for investment purposes.
Mathwig's occupation is president of Metro Sales Inc of Richfield, Minn.
Atrix makes remote metering and copy control products, as well as vaccums, vacuum filters and printed circuit board transport cases.
